# Horizontal Data Slicing

## Internal Slicing: Row Groups

Breaks the data into horizontal chunks called **Row Groups** (typically every 128 MB to 512 MB of data).

Row Group Skipping - skip a data block if a search ID not within the min_id and max_id of the block.


## External Slicing: Directory Partitioning

Small File Problem (or Over-partitioning) - partitioning by unique values (such as unique user_id).

# TIPS

Only partition by columns that have low cardinality (ideally under 100 unique values) and are heavily filtered on, such as `year`, `month`, `region`, or `status`.
